title: A Flashy Zimbabwean Tycoon Who Befriended Presidents Dies in Crash
summary_full: Wicknell Chivayo was riding in a helicopter with his wife when it plunged into a field. Dogged by corruption allegations, the businessman drew polarizing reactions even in death.
